description: Defines a template class PacketNumberIndexedQueue for managing a queue of packet entries indexed by packet number, supporting operations like insertion, removal, and retrieval, with internal circular deque storage.

classes.name: PacketNumberIndexedQueue
classes.description: A queue data structure for packet entries indexed by packet number, optimized for ordered insertions and removals, with internal hazard considerations.

methods.name: GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the entry associated with a specific packet number.

methods.name: Emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new entry at a specified packet number, filling missing intermediate entries.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with a specific packet number, optionally calling a function on the entry before removal.

methods.name: RemoveUpTo
methods.description: Removes all entries up to a specified packet number.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes unused slots from the front of the internal deque.
